profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a background in Semi-Conductor Manufacturing. Skilled in Statistical Data Analysis, Java, Go, LaTeX, and Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR/MRI). Strong engineering professional with a PhD in Physical Chemistry from University of California, Berkeley.

positions.title: Senior Adaptive Instruction Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for understanding and improving the overall quality of the outputs of an educational recommendation engine, user-facing analytics, and internal student modeling. Used student simulator to both predict and reproduce recommendations and analytics from complex modeling engine.
• Designed and built analysis tools with Python which are used by entire team to troubleshoot problematic recommendations and analytics reported by users
• Created automated testing framework and targeted tests to verify model contracts are being met
• Trained teammates in root cause analysis and design of quantitative metrics providing insight into user experience
• Transformed QA process from manual front-end tests to automated and semi-automated test batteries, changing QA iteration cycles from a multi-day process to a task runnable in the background, requiring only minutes of active time.
• Wrote and executed test plans for proposed changes in any model or feature which could impact student recommendations or analytics; presented results to internal modeling, product, and externally-facing teams

positions.title: Process Engineer
positions.description:
Improved overall design and performance of a silicon-etching tool for through-silicon-via applications. Supported customer factory, monitoring tool performance and verifying chamber matching. Developed new processes for W recess, gate, and spacer applications.

* Designed PID-based pressure control algorithm for fast pressure switching; worked closely with software group to test, debug, and improve resulting program
* Analyzed high-speed data (resolution of 15 ms) to determine repeatability of pressure and gas-flow response over thousands of switching cycles; developed reusable templates to repeat analysis for future tests
* Designed and analyzed experiments to quantify process sensitivity to different hardware components; used resulting data to construct statistical models to account for and correct chamber-to-chamber variations
* Wrote documentation and procedures describing operation of new hardware and software products; regularly presented work to colleagues and supervisors

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Worked on PHP- and SQL-driven web applications.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher/Instructor
positions.description:
Developed methodology to perform Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy and imaging on microfluidic chip devices.

* Designed and built customer equipment such as NMR probes and flow apparati
* Maintained group website and databases using PHP, MySQL, and XHTML
* Improved sensitivity and flexibility for microscale NMR
* Studied multiphasic mixing of fluid in microchannels

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Interned at oil services company and applied new spectroscopic techniques to better predict presence of oil. Developed NMR imaging experiments to determine spatial distribution of pore sizes and porosities.

* Applied recently-developed pulse sequences to new research problem; wrote customized pulse sequences to quickly extract more information from MRI data
* Developed fitting techniques and statistical methods to remove outlier bias; confirmed the reliability of the analysis scheme
* Created innovative plotting technique for cumbersome 3-dimensional data, allowed a 2D representation while maintaining spatial information
* Applied techniques to a model set containing a range of rock sample types
